name: Bill Jiao
title: CEO
conviction_themes: LLMs can be applied to real-time perception tasks (e.g. detecting blinks)
Sparse attention and hardware-level optimizations are key to making LLMs faster and more efficient
Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT/LoRA) makes LLM specialization practical without massive compute
Online RL from user interactions (implicit feedback as reward signal) is a promising LLM training paradigm
Problems worth solving come first — the most successful companies don't start with a product

Previously connected to MIT (met co-founder at MIT before heading to YC)

bio_text: Bill Jiao (Zhandong Jiao) is the CEO and co-founder of General Instinct (YC P26), a company built alongside a longtime collaborator from their shared ML vision research days. He has demonstrated deep interest in LLM efficiency, real-time AI perception, and parameter-efficient fine-tuning. Bill is an early-stage founder in the YC P26 batch, operating at the intersection of applied ML research and product.
